She recently reintroduced the Social Security Fairness Act to eliminate the WEP and GPO. She joins me now to discuss the provisions and the survey. Welcome back to the program.
So what do the Windfall Elimination Provision and Government Pension Offset do to the finances of public servants and retirees?

Well, what I have heard consistently from my constituents is that they make their retirement harder, that they take social security dollars that they had planned for, that they had paid into, and that they had worked for, unavailable to them in retirement. It makes him worried. about his wife and what sort of survivor benefits she might receive or not receive based on these punitive provisions. In fact, last town hall we had a gentleman from another part of our district, longtime federal employee had served overseas in that role and he is impacted by the weapon GPO and wants to know what Congress is doing.
